subject.title: fix(gateway): don't retire parent Codex binding when creating a detached dashboard child

question: Should `sessions.create` gain and retain a public `succeedsParent` disposition that changes parent lifecycle-hook semantics, now that current main already preserves the affected Codex binding?
rationale: The answer determines the durable gateway/plugin lifecycle contract for existing hooks and out-of-tree clients; source inspection and tests cannot establish that intended product boundary.

options.title: Keep the current guard and defer the API
options.body: Treat merged Codex cross-key preservation as the bug fix and defer this public lifecycle API until a broader plugin contract requires it.

options.title: Adopt explicit succession
options.body: Accept `succeedsParent` as the canonical cross-client lifecycle disposition and document compatibility expectations for hook consumers.

options.title: Narrow the proposal
options.body: Retain a producer-side correction only if owners identify a concrete shared-plugin invariant that cannot be covered by the existing Codex guard.

recommendation.title: Keep the current guard and defer the API
recommendation.body: Treat merged Codex cross-key preservation as the bug fix and defer this public lifecycle API until a broader plugin contract requires it.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the currently shipped `emitCommandHooks` lifecycle contract that the new disposition would extend.
